actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.name: ticks

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

device.name: Video to Data G1 29dof MuJoCo scene

facts.text: The repository describes itself as an end-to-end pipeline that converts human demonstration videos into simulation-ready assets and physics-grounded robot training data.
The robotic-grounding stage retargets human motion onto a robot embodiment and drives Isaac Lab environments trained with RSL-RL PPO.
The G1 whole-body planner loads its MuJoCo scene from planner/assets/mujoco/scene_29dof.xml.
The planner constructs a MuJoCo model from that XML path with mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path, then a mujoco.MjData and mujoco.mj_forward.
The scene is a MuJoCo model named 'g1_29dof scene' that includes g1_29dof.xml.
The scene's worldbody adds a directional light and a floor plane to the included robot model.
The G1 model compiles angles in radians and resolves its meshes from ../../../assets/meshes/g1.
The pelvis body starts at pos 0 0 0.793 and carries the free joint floating_base_joint.
The actuator block declares 29 <motor> actuators, one per actuated G1 joint, each with an explicit ctrlrange.
The hip motors state ctrlrange -88 88, the knee motors -139 139 and the ankle motors -50 50.
The waist yaw motor states ctrlrange -88 88 and the waist roll and pitch motors -50 50.
The shoulder, elbow and wrist-roll motors state ctrlrange -25 25; the wrist pitch and yaw motors state -5 5.
The model asset directory's NOTICE says the G1 and Dex3 robot descriptions are from or derived from Unitree G1 Description assets and are licensed under the BSD 3-Clause License.
The model asset directory's LICENSE is the BSD 3-Clause License of Unitree Robotics.
The robotic_grounding package setup declares license 'Apache 2.0'.
FlashCHORD's RLEnv constructor requires a Scene and Reference and accepts an optional RLEnvConfig.
RLEnv.step accepts an optional Warp action array and returns observation, reward, done and truncation buffers.
The FlashCHORD runtime describes MuJoCo-Warp through Newton's SolverMuJoCo, with CPU or CUDA selected by where the model's Warp arrays live.

determinism.notes: Event-driven placeholder integration with no contact, constraint or force solver; the same control input reproduces the same placeholder state hash, but this is a stand-in digest, not a MuJoCo trajectory or state-hash replay.

gaps: the fake is a package-local stand-in for the mujoco module: it parses the MJCF and its include for shape, qpos0 and ctrlranges, but it loads no meshes, textures, inertias or contacts and runs no MuJoCo physics

each motor's force (gear * ctrl) accelerates only its own hinge against a placeholder unit inertia with a placeholder damping; the free base, gravity, contacts, friction, joint limits, force limits and sensor physics are not integrated
the model states no <option timestep>; the fake's 2 ms tick is a placeholder matching MuJoCo's library default, not a model value
reset restores qpos0 from the MJCF (pelvis at 0 0 0.793 with an identity quaternion, the 29 hinges at ref 0), as mj_resetData does
the snapshot uses the bridge's basic profile (time, qpos, qvel, act and ctrl) because the stand-in exposes no mj_getState/mj_setState; warm-start and derived quantities are not preserved
flash_chord.envs.rl:RLEnv, the Isaac Lab tasks and the FlashCHORD/Newton/Warp/JAX stack are NOT COVERED

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.

safe_state.description: The simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no cap.world.step.v1 or cap.world.reset.v1 call is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, while the integration state and stored ctrl remain readable. Safety reset advances no ticks and does not clear ctrl; a later explicit step without an action reuses it. This stops only this in-process model, not FlashCHORD or an external Isaac application.
